subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB566
title: For the part of the state located in the Pacific Time Zone, abolishes the annual one-hour change in time from standard time to daylight saving time and maintains the Pacific Time Zone portion of Oregon on standard time for all 12 months of the calendar year, if California and Washington make the same change within the next 10 years.
headline: SB 566 did not pass

claims.text: SB 566 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 566 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
